title: powerops settings validate --format json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops settings validate --format json': the problems found when a deployment settings file is checked against a solution.

solution.description: Unique name of the checked solution.

settings.description: The settings file path as given on the command line.

problems.description: Sorted by component type, name, kind. Empty when the file is clean.

kind.description: missing: in the solution, not in the file. extra: in the file, not in the solution. duplicate: the name is listed more than once in the file (the first entry is the one checked). emptyConnectionId: connection reference without a ConnectionId. emptyValue: environment variable with no value in the file and no default or current value in the solution.

name.description: Environment variable schema name or connection reference logical name.
